name: Milly McCarthy and the Christmas Calamity by Leona Forde

pages.title: Milly Mccarthy And The Christmas Calamity By Leona Forde
pages.description: A festive school concert heads cheerfully towards disaster in Milly McCarthy And The Christmas Calamity, a funny middle-grade story. Free Delivery Over €10
pages.ld_description:
With Christmas around the corner, Milly’s class is gearing up for their festive end-of-term concert, where everyone gets to showcase their favorite talent.
Milly is excited to join in—though she never expected such a starring role… and, honestly, it was NOT her fault that she brought the house down (literally)!
Get ready for a hilarious holiday mishap featuring our favorite cailín from Cork!
Ideal for readers who:

Are partial to festive stories with plenty of comic disruption
Would relish watching a school concert edge steadily towards catastrophe
Like children’s fiction rooted in friendships, teachers and end-of-term excitement
Prefer humour that feels warm, busy and full of personality
